task.claim: The in-vitro finding for CXCL8 (IL-8) — human chemokine with no mouse ortholog (CXCL8) persists across the mouse vs human axis.
task.instruction: Using only the evidence package and context datasets provided (and the listed tools if you judge more evidence is needed), decide whether the in-vitro finding described in the claim is corroborated across the in-vivo and patient contexts.
